title: note_to_article injects attacker-controlled content into RFC 5322 headers without CRLF stripping
description: inbound.rs note_to_article() constructs RFC 5322 article bytes using format!() with Note fields (content, from, subject, published) that come directly from the remote ActivityPub POST body. These fields are not passed through strip_crlf(). A malicious remote server can inject CRLF sequences into the article headers, forging arbitrary headers (e.g. Newsgroups, Message-ID) in the injected article. The email/set.rs create path applies strip_crlf(); the AP inbound path does not.
